content: Kweiboug Elod nibob kayob Yon

Misiya̱mun towen gabman yagan Elod iligen butun Yeisuw, mapuna idibakes natouwats, ilana, “Mtowen tabibapta̱ysein gamags yagan Yon, kweiboug abob kayon, imat, adok bo ikit vayuwein, mapun nawotet tut towen singay tawtoun.”

E, kweiboug Elod niyous Yon, iyawen naman, isen wa̱deil, peinan Elod nikwey bwadan Pilip nakwav Elodiyas, Yon nilivan, “Awoum kukwey bwadam nakwav.” Elod sivinan beiweiy mtowen Yon, mapuna iyous, isen wa̱deil, anpwa̱yat gog beiweiy Yon, peinan gamag babaw sivines Yon, idokes palopit teitan.

Wankuyeim isagal, peinan tutan inan nikop-yay, mtowen Elod ikamkwams siney nagamags. Elodiyas natun kuda̱vin isal wamtes tawaw tasiyas, Elod ikalin nuwan, idibek, ilana, “Aveiyag sivinam bo basekeim, tabudabod tamag.”

Na̱wen in ikatugwan inan waseg, ilana, “Inag, aveiyag banitoug?” Inan ilana, “Kunitoug busbwesan Yon bisekeim.” Inek Elod, ilana, “Kusekeig busbwesan tabibapta̱ysein gamags, towen Yon. Bibwabwes kayon, busbwesan bisenas wanuwan abmavin, mo kusekeig.”
King towen mo igeg nanon, tage peinan gamag babaw niliganes nitabudabod anilivan, mo itam.
Itam, ikayeb teitan in wa̱deil, ibob kayon Yon, busbwesan isen wakabmavin, imey, isek guwa̱vin, ikow inow, isek inan.
Yon navamul iliganes, ineis, ikawes won Yon, inawes idibwanis. Ikous, inekes Yeisuw, ikamteles sinap towen.
Yeisuw ivakamus gamag kweinim tawsan
Yeisuw iligen sinap towen, ilisawes gamag babaw, itouw wa̱wag, ikala̱vis ineis ven makaw waseg. Gamag babaw iliganes liva̱nen bo itouw, ilisawes siven kweitan, inoys gog wa̱ked, ikikuns Yeisuw waseg.
Yeisuw ilug, ikin gamag singay babaw, ikalin nuwan, takatouns ivag mo ibweins.
Iwwotet ee... kwayav; navamul inekes, ilansa, “Bo ikwayav, kwayabes gamag babaw bineis waven mwasanin biyamiyises kaeis, peinan nawoud towen nag kweitan ven nises.”
Yeisuw gog ikayuses, ilana, “Awoum bineis. Kusekes kaeis beikams.”
Ilansa, “Kan nag. Misinaka bled kweinim, in mwanay.”

Ilana, “Kumeyes bakin; gamag babaw bisinis awuyow wakunuwatan, beikams.” Ikow bled son in wanaman, ikin wanakaew, ikalin nuwan waseg Yowbad, mo initoug. Ikous mo ikikiv bled issekes navamul, ikawes ivakamus gamag babaw, ikams, ikamuweips. Kan nikambwages isiyavis, idagis in wanuwan kaynad; bo ika̱lawt kaynad sinawatan kadiney.
Gamag siyas neikams kweinim tawsan tawaw, sisiyas vinay gamagal babaw.
Yeisuw inoun wakunuwatan yevagam
Ikous, mo idibakes navamul, ilana, “Kutouws kumugwas, kusupels kuneis palatan; yey gog bases bakayabes gamag.”
Ikayabes ikous, ikatulag in wa̱koy, anmwa̱net binitoug Yowbad waseg. Bo iboug anmwa̱neta ises.
Tasiyas gog wa̱wag kadiveiyov-o wabwanit ikalla̱vis, bo ikala̱lav nimes, peinan yag meinoy neim wamtes.
Kakita beiyam, Yeisuw mo inoun wakunuwatan yevagam, bo binekes.
Navamul ikines Yeisuw ininoun wakunuwatan yevagam, idokes yeiluw kid, iwkuwaksa aspwa̱yat.
Yeisuw ilana, “Bwein-wan! Awoum beivag amipwa̱yat. Yey nases.”
Iw to Pita, ilana, “Guyaw, magat mounid ya̱koum, kudibakeig baw, mo banoun wakunuwatan yevagam, bawekeim.”
Yeisuw ilana, “Kum.” Pita mo ilisow wag, inoun wakunuwatan yevagam binek kid Yeisuw.
Igaw ininoun, ikin yag itotow, anpwa̱yat, kaken bo isoun, kakita bo bimukul. Iwak, ilana, “Guyaw kwatinabweig!”
Yeisuw iyasel naman, iyous, ilana, “Adok nag kusimounid waseg yey. Aveiyag wawun ivag nanoum akweiy?”
Iyums asteiy inekes tasiyas wa̱wag, itouws, yag mo iyenom.
Tasiyas wag aniwnataw mo ikululs wamatan Yeisuw, ilansa, “Mounid Yowbad Natun yak.”
Genesalet gimgilis ivag mo ibweins
Isupels, ilugs ven yagan Genesalet.

Min-Genesalet iwtusis Yeisuw, ikayabes sisiyas, ineis vena babaw, idibakes takatouns, ilansa, “Kwatuyouns kunekes Yeisuw.” Inekes, initougs waseg, sivines kid misinaka bikabkwanes matan anakweim. Itam, ikabkwanes, mo ibweins.
